name: Dumbbell Lying Leg Curl
cues: Lie face down with your knees just past the bench end
Squeeze one dumbbell vertically between your feet
Curl it up until your shins are near vertical
Lower slowly while keeping the dumbbell locked between your feet

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-08 (bulk approval of wave 3a). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated minor, owner review. minor: Prone, knees just past the bench end, dumbbell vertical between the feet at the top (knee 95, shins vertical). ROM is only 45 to 95 (the template's research range is 5 to 110), so the stretch end stops with the shins about 45 deg above horizontal. Reads correctly otherwise.
